how_these_calls_were_made: Called over the MCP stdio protocol by a FastMCP Client against mcp_server/mcp_server.py. The .mcp.json entry was added during this session, and Claude Code loads MCP servers only at startup, so the server was not yet callable as mcp__campus-customs__* from the vibecoder itself. The prompts below are the ones driving each call; the tool outputs are the real, unedited responses from the server.

tests.prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants a Classic Bulldog Tee, SKU CC-TEE-WHITE, size S. Use the campus-customs MCP server to check whether we have it in stock.
Ticket 102: Elm City Properties emailed that shop rent is due in 2 days. Use the campus-customs MCP server to pull the actual lease terms for lease 1 so we can verify the amount and the due date.

Ticket 103: the Yale AI Club wants 20 navy hoodies (CC-HOOD-NAVY) in size M at a bulk discount. Use the campus-customs MCP server to get the recorded cost and list price for that SKU so we know our margin floor.
